# Sree Svadista Prasada

> Authentic Telugu / Andhra home-style South Indian kitchen in Greenleys, Milton Keynes. Order online for collection. Two menus: Svadista (non-vegetarian) and Prasada (vegetarian).

## About

Sree Svadista Prasada cooks South Indian food the way it is made at home in Andhra and Telangana. Svadista is the non-vegetarian menu — curries, biryanis, starters. Prasada is the vegetarian menu, and includes a Naivedyam section of temple-style offerings prepared without onion or garlic.

We also offer:
- South Indian breakfast (dosa, idli, vada, upma, pongal)
- Street food
- Ragi (finger millet) specialities
- Drinks
- Dabba Wala: a weekly or monthly home-cooked meal plan for Milton Keynes
- Catering for events and functions (by enquiry)

## Location and service

- **Kitchen:** 24 Oxman Ln, Greenleys, Milton Keynes MK12 6LF
- **Collection:** order online and collect from the kitchen at a chosen time slot.
- **Delivery:** Milton Keynes postcodes only, when switched on. Check the order page for whether delivery is currently available.
- **Dine-in:** not offered.
- **Edinburgh and Glasgow:** planned, not yet open.
- **Pickles and podis:** coming soon, not yet available to order.

## Ordering

- Minimum order £15.
- Collection orders get 10% off.
- Card payment online. Guests can order without an account.
- Every fifth completed order on an account earns a free dish.

## Dabba Wala meal plan

- Weekly plan: 5 meals. Monthly plan: 20 meals. Delivered on weekdays within Milton Keynes.
- Vegetarian (Prasada) or non-vegetarian (Svadista) box.
- Paid up front; plans do not auto-renew.
- Individual days can be skipped from the customer dashboard. For anything else — pausing, changing or cancelling — customers contact the kitchen.
